description: Introduction and overview of the B-2 Spirit: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The B-2 Spirit is a four-engine stealth flying-wing strategic bomber built by Northrop, entering service in 1997. Its seamless flying-wing shape gives it a tiny radar signature for penetrating defended airspace. Only 21 were built at over $2 billion each in program cost terms; all are based at Whiteman Air Force Base, Missouri. Baseline facts: Stealth flying-wing strategic bomber; USAF service from 1997; 21 built by Northrop Grumman..
